group.label: Memoirs · Journal of a Newbie Officer

lines.text: By now, everyone knows about the Goddess Squad. Tune into any broadcast, and it's nothing but the Goddess Squad.
The Goddess Squad's commander's popularity among the younger officers is something else.
I've seen more than a few of them get smacked upside the head by their superiors for walking around in sunglasses, trying to copy his style.
According to a colleague who's always up on the latest news, the Goddess Squad's practice of assigning a human commander to a Nikke unit might become standard procedure in the future.
I guess that's as good as saying the higher-ups have recognized his achievements.
If that's the case, could an opportunity come my way, too?
As usual, I go to bed imagining myself commanding Nikkes. The sunglasses I ordered should probably arrive tomorrow.
(There's a doodle in the corner, seemingly of him commanding Nikkes while wearing sunglasses.)
